ablation_analysis.velocity_ablation_note: Velocity signals require multi-message temporal event streams (sender/IP sliding windows). Velocity contributions are evaluated under synthetic multi-message velocity sweeps in test_telecom_gateway.py.

training_config.architecture: TfidfVectorizer(ngram_range=(1,2), sublinear_tf=True, token_pattern=r'\b[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\b') -> CalibratedClassifierCV(LogisticRegression(C=1.5, class_weight=balanced), method=sigmoid, cv=5)

oof_cross_validation.protocol: Nested 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold outer/inner with Pipeline(TfidfVectorizer -> LogisticRegression) fitted strictly inside inner calibration splits (zero vocabulary leakage)
